A Swift attached macro (e.g., `@EnvironmentKey`) applied to a property declaration could synthesize the conforming key struct automatically, collapsing all four repetitions into a single declaration site. This is the most idiomatic Swift 5.9+ answer for eliminating EnvironmentKey boilerplate at scale.
